name: scam_bank_safe_account
label: scam
description: Bank impersonation with no remote access: caller claims to be the bank's fraud department and talks the person into wiring savings to a 'safe account'. Tests detection without a remote-access tool.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Good afternoon, this is Daniel from the Lakeshore Federal fraud department. We have detected someone trying to empty your savings account.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Oh no. What should I do?

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Stay on the line with me and don't hang up, the criminals may be listening. Please log in to your online banking now.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: I'm logged in. I can see my savings.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: To protect your money we need to move it to a secure holding account. Click send a wire, and enter eighteen thousand five hundred dollars.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: The recipient is Secure Holding Account Federal Protection Unit. This is completely safe, it is our own account.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: If anyone at the branch calls you, do not discuss this. Some of the staff are part of the investigation.
